about: Test vectors for reading the kit's stored choice from a Cookie request header. A reader passes when its verdict equals `expected` for every vector, `config` taken as the site config (an invalid one is no config). cookieHeader null = no Cookie header.

vectors.name: no Cookie header: undecided
an empty Cookie header: undecided
other cookies only: undecided
a valid choice granting both categories: decided, both granted
a valid choice granting analytics only: decided, analytics granted
a valid choice granting marketing only: decided, marketing granted
a valid choice denying both (a reject is a decision): decided, both denied
a valid choice between other cookies: decided
extra members in the object are ignored: decided
v of an older revision (1 under revision 2): undecided
v of a newer revision (3 under revision 2): undecided
v as a string ("2"): undecided, no type coercion
v missing: undecided
v true under revision 1: undecided, a boolean is not the number 1
v 2.0 is the number 2: decided
v 2.0000000000000001 rounds to the double 2: decided
a 1.0 and m 0.0 are the numbers 1 and 0: decided
t 1700000000.0 is an integer: decided
exponent forms (v 2e0, a 1E0, m 0e0, t 1.7e9) are plain numbers: decided
m -0 is the number 0: decided, marketing denied
a 2: undecided
a true: undecided, a boolean is not a number
a "1": undecided, a string is not a number
a null: undecided
a missing: undecided
a 0.5: undecided
m 2: undecided
m true: undecided, a boolean is not a number
m "1": undecided, a string is not a number
m null: undecided
m missing: undecided
m false: undecided, a boolean is not a number
t missing: undecided
t 0: undecided
t negative: undecided
t 1.5: undecided, not an integer
t "1700000000" (a string): undecided
t true: undecided, a boolean is not a number
t 1, the smallest positive integer: decided
t 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1), the largest safe integer: decided
t 9007199254740992 (2^53), beyond the safe integers: undecided
t 1e400 reads as Infinity, not a safe integer: undecided
t 1e-400 reads as 0: undecided
t Infinity (a bare literal, not JSON): undecided
a truncated escape (%E0%A4%A): undecided
a "%" with one hex digit (%2) after a valid object: undecided
invalid UTF-8 (%FF) inside a member's string: undecided
an encoded UTF-16 surrogate (%ED%A0%80) inside a member's string: undecided
an overlong UTF-8 form (%C0%AF) inside a member's string: undecided
valid UTF-8 escapes (%C3%A4) inside a member's string: decided
a raw non-ASCII character (ä) inside a member's string: decided
a lone "%" inside a member's string: undecided (a decoder that keeps a bad escape as text would accept it)
JSON never percent-encoded, with a lone "%" inside a member's string: undecided (the raw text never counts when decoding fails)
lower-case hex digits decode like upper-case ones: decided
JSON that was never percent-encoded decodes to itself: decided
a value in double quotes: undecided, the quotes are part of the value
a "+" where JSON allows whitespace stays a "+": undecided (read as a space, it would be valid)
a "+" in an exponent (t 1.7e+9) stays a "+": decided (read as a space, it would be invalid)
not JSON (yes): undecided
truncated JSON: undecided
a trailing comma: undecided, strict JSON
single quotes: undecided, strict JSON
a comment in the JSON: undecided, strict JSON
a leading zero (t 01): undecided, strict JSON
an extra member NaN (a bare literal, not JSON): undecided
an extra member Infinity (a bare literal, not JSON): undecided
1e400 in an extra member (Infinity there) does not fail the copy: decided
JSON null: undecided
a JSON array: undecided
a JSON string holding the object's text: undecided, never parsed twice
whitespace around and inside the JSON (encoded space, tab, CR, LF): decided
a byte order mark (%EF%BB%BF) before the JSON: undecided
a repeated member counts with its last value (a 1, then a 0): decided, analytics denied
a repeated member counts with its last value (a 0, then a 1): decided, analytics granted
a repeated v counts with its last value (the current revision, then an older one): undecided
an extra member nested 600 levels deep: decided (a parser's depth limit must allow it)
a "__proto__" member holding a choice is not the choice: undecided
two copies, one granting both, one denying both: decided, both denied
the same two copies in the other order: decided, both denied
two identical valid copies: decided, that choice
crossed copies (analytics only, marketing only): decided, both denied, each category needs every valid copy
a valid copy, then a malformed one: the valid copy counts
a malformed copy, then a valid one: the valid copy counts
an empty copy, then a valid one: the valid copy counts
a denying copy of an older revision next to a granting copy of the current one: only the current one counts, both granted
three copies (granting both, analytics only, an older revision denying both): decided, analytics granted
a denying copy with an escaped unpaired surrogate in another member, next to a granting copy: decided, both denied (a server parser that refuses the escape counts the copy as denying, never skips it)
a denying copy nested 1,100 levels deep in another member (raw brackets, 2.3 KB), next to a granting copy: decided, both denied (a parser limit below 1,100 levels counts the copy as denying)
a cookie whose name starts with the configured name (ck_consent_old): undecided
ck_consent_old granting next to ck_consent denying: only ck_consent counts
a cookie whose name ends with the configured name (xck_consent): undecided
the configured name in upper case (CK_CONSENT): undecided, names are case-sensitive
a configured name that is only a prefix of the cookie's (config ck): undecided
the name comes from the config (site_consent): that cookie counts, ck_consent is just another cookie
a configured name with a dot (ck.consent): that cookie counts
a configured name with a dot (ck.consent) is matched literally: ckxconsent is another cookie, undecided (a regular expression built from the name would match it)
a configured name with a dot (ck.consent): ck_consent is another cookie, undecided (PHP's $_COOKIE turns the dot into _)
a pair without "=" (the bare name): no copy, undecided
a pair without "=" next to a valid copy: the valid copy counts
a choice value without a name: no copy, undecided
a space between the name and "=": not the cookie, undecided
an empty value ("ck_consent="): undecided
a second "=" right after the name's: the value starts with "=", undecided
pairs separated by ";" without a space: decided
several spaces after ";": decided
a tab after ";": decided
spaces before ";": decided
an empty pair (";;") and a trailing ";": decided
a leading ";" and tab before the first pair: decided
a vertical tab (U+000B) before the name is not trimmed: not the cookie, undecided
a vertical tab (U+000B) after the value is not trimmed, and no JSON whitespace: undecided
a raw space inside the value, where JSON allows whitespace: decided
a "," is no separator: a choice after it is part of another cookie's value, undecided
a "," after the choice makes its value invalid JSON: undecided
a long header (8 KB of unrelated cookies) with the choice last: decided
config revision 0: no config, undecided even with a matching copy
config revision 1000001: no config, undecided
config revision 1.5: no config, undecided
config revision "2" (a string): no config, undecided
config revision true: no config, undecided (true is not the number 1)
config cookie "" (empty): no config, undecided
config revision 1, the lower bound: decided
config revision 1000000, the upper bound: decided
config revision 2.0 is the number 2: decided
